cost: THE PIN IS RE-CUT, NOT DELETED. `Zion Williamson '21 off 92 +-1` (round 156, his 'Push 154-157') moves to data/anchors_superseded.json with his own new word, and `Zion Williamson '21 off 90 +-1` (round 190) takes its place. 193 anchors, 0 failing.

HIS NUMBER WAS 86 +-3 AND THIS IS THE FRONTIER, ACCEPTED ON 'Push 194'. 86 is not reachable in o_score. The subject's o_score is 98.529 and the dominance bonus is only 4.990 of it, so even CONFISCATING the whole term reads him 87. Measured end to end, one knob at a time, every other anchor held: the attempt ceiling reaches 90 and stops on Shaquille O'Neal '02; recal_44's gate floor reaches 91 and stops on Moses Malone '82; recal_131's evidence cap is infeasible at every K (Dwight Howard '11 needs K >= 0.3684, the subject needs K <= 0.3586); and no reweighting of o_score's ten dials reads him below 91 under recal_89's held-total rule. The one form that reaches 89 — ceiling 1.80 WITH gate floor 0.205 — was measured and rejected: both constants are fitted to the frontier, Moses '82 is left with 0.007 of o_score, and Shaq '00/'01/'02 all fall to 98.

WHERE THE REMAINING FOUR POINTS LIVE, so a later round is not sent back into this term. The subject's standard path (93.538) sits 2.661 UNDER Shaq '00's and 15.6 OVER Dwight Howard '11's, and the whole of that 15.6 is in three bars that are not about the paint at all: playvol 55 against 21 (+6.46 of o_score), ballsec 60 against 21 (+3.90) and volume 89 against 79 (+2.60). notes: THE SUBJECT, DECOMPOSED (npm run explain, before). Zion Williamson '21, OFF 92 / DEF 64 / OVR 84 on 27.0 points, 3.7 assists, 33.2 minutes, usage 29.8, TS .649, BPM 5.8. o_score 98.5286 x 0.93 = raw 91.6316, BELOW the 93 knee, so band() is the identity and the band anchors are not in this ruling. Standard path 93.538 and the zone-dominance bonus +4.990 = base 6.50 x zone_f 1.1000 x att_f 2.7917 x gate_f 0.2500. Nothing else fires: recal_131's paint-evidence floor computes 0.30 x 75.40 = 22.62 against a zone block of 24.34 and pays +0.000; the hub never opens (playvol 55 under the gate 60); recal_107's two-level big, recal_112's efficient interior scorer, recal_121's turnover charge (which names him as spared: 'poor ball security is not enough on its own: all four convert') and recal_182's second-chance floor all pay zero. AFTER: att_f 2.7917 -> 2.0000, bonus 4.990 -> 3.575, o_score 97.113, raw 90.315 -> OFF 90.

HE WAS THE CARD THAT MADE THE CEILING VISIBLE, and that is the honest way round: the clamp was written at 2.85 by recal_47 and the board's maximum is 2.7917, which is the subject's own. A ceiling no card can touch is not a ceiling. What was actually pricing him was an unbounded power on a RATE — 14.87 self-created paint attempts a hundred — and the class it prices has its p90 at 7.71 attempts (att_f 1.0419) and its p99 at 13.32 (2.3668). He is the maximum of 855 cards on the input, and the term paid him accordingly.

WHY THE DISPATCH'S TWO HYPOTHESES WERE BOTH WRONG, recorded because they were reasonable. (1) A ONE-ZONE GATE is backwards: Shaq '00 is mid 23 / 3pt 2 and Shaq '02 is mid 6 / 3pt 2 against the subject's mid 32, so a gate on a missing second zone cuts the doctrine card HARDER than the card the ruling names. (2) recal_131's PAINT-EVIDENCE FLOOR pays the subject +0.000, so there is no second payment of the paint claim to net off — and the one-claim-one-payment cap that would follow from it cannot separate him from Dwight Howard '11, whose evidence is 74.21 against his 75.40 and whose zone block is 22.96 against 24.34.

WHY SHAQ SURVIVES A CEILING THAT MOVES THE SUBJECT, stated as arithmetic. Shaq '00's bonus is 18.176 to the subject's 4.990 on a nearly identical attempt rate (13.97 against 14.87 per 100), because the subject's free-throw stroke (70) already sits on recal_44's gate FLOOR at 0.2500 while Shaq's (52) sits at the gate's TOP, 1.0000. So every factor the two share has a 3.76:1 lever against the subject — which is exactly why the ceiling is the only knob that moves him a useful distance, and exactly why it runs out at 90: Shaq '02 leaves 98 +-1 below a ceiling of 1.51553 and the subject does not print 89 until 1.50971, a gap of 0.0058 in the constant and 0.047 of his o_score.

THE MEASUREMENT: the variant harness ran 60 parameterisations across seven families (this ceiling, the attempt exponent and hinge, the paint base, the zone_f ceiling, recal_44's gate re-read on the whole fouldraw term and on recal_131's evidence, the evidence cap, recal_44's 'already paid' gate carried to the paint branch, and every single-weight and redistributed reweighting of o_score's ten dials), each graded against every standing OFF anchor plus the named walls. Not one reads the subject below 90 with the board held. The class quantiles are measured on the 855 measured-era cards this branch pays.

FOOTPRINT: 9 of 10,000 cards move on OFF, EVERY ONE OF THEM DOWN, max -2, mean -1.33; DEF moves on ZERO and every attribute moves on ZERO; OVR follows on 8, max -2. The nine are one class and read like it — Shaquille O'Neal '97, '98, '99, '02, '03, '05, Giannis Antetokounmpo '19 and '23, and the subject: the measured-era seasons whose self-created paint diet is the busiest on the board. The top 12 by OFF is UNCHANGED: Giannis '23 was 99 and is 98, but the 99 tier is deeper than twelve and the printed listing is alphabetical, so no name enters or leaves it.
